title: Everybody Is Carrying Something // Darante' LaMar

top_liked.author: @somersetcace1
top_liked.text:
Great message and a solid path forward. One of the biggest lies I had to overcome as a younger man was the notion that airing out your struggles, or asking for help is a weakness.

The truth is, looking someone I respect in the eye and saying “no, I’m not okay” is one of the…
